final_assessment: Measured the migration on real upstream projects (Case 1: orbit init silently builds an empty orbit/ beside openspec/; the manual move works for 1.3.1) and classified upstream 1.4-1.14.1 against orbit's engine (Case 2: eleven hazards, five silent). Eight decisions: D-cd-1 an orbit init warning (Sal: b; needs an R-ugd-3 carve-out ruled in an architect session), D-cd-2 its trigger, D-cd-3 exit (2) ranges over what orbit adds or changes, D-cd-4 a 1.14 project is not a drop-in (fact), D-cd-5 the before-you-move checklist, D-cd-6 exit (3) on a fresh 1.14.1 project with one fixture per hazard, D-cd-7 a checked Carried by: line per H2 section, D-cd-8 supported-tools in two tiers held to AI_TOOLS. One open question, Q-cd-8, is the program's: whether orbit cherry-picks upstream fixes before going public.

residuals.kind: an orbit change to inherited behaviour that no capability states and that is not D12, D13 or D15, so a page could present it as inherited or as a capability claim
residuals.method: diff the page's claim against the upstream `1.3.1` tag (`git diff upstream/v1.3.1 -- <path>`) when the system review reads the page for orbit behaviour

residuals.kind: a post-1.3.1 on-disk form Case 2 missed (its four unverified items: brace or extglob `generates`, symlinked schema directories, `.openspec-workspace/`, Copilot cloud-agent files) or one upstream ships after 1.14.1
residuals.method: exit (3)'s recorded run on a 1.14.1 project (D-cd-6) for the first; for the second, the guide names the upstream version it was measured against, and a later stage re-reads upstream's changelog from there
